cues.en: We're not just talking about turning one kind of collection into another kind of collection. A transducer that's running on a channel has got an arbitrary amount of stuff coming through. A transducer on an event stream has an arbitrary amount of stuff coming through. But sometimes you want either the reducing process or somebody who says, whoa, I've had enough. I don't want to see any more input. We're done. I want to say we're done now, even though you may have more input. So we're going to call that early termination. And it may be desired by the process itself, like the thing at the bottom.
cues.zh: 我们不只是讨论把一种集合转换成另一种集合。运行在通道上的 transducer 会有任意数量的东西经过。事件流上的 transducer 也会有任意数量的东西经过。但有时你希望归约过程或某个人说，哇，我受够了。我不想再看到更多输入了。我们结束了。我想现在就说结束，即使你可能还有更多输入。所以我们把它叫做提前终止。它可能是过程本身想要的，就像最底下那个东西。

cues.en: Or it may be a function of one of the steps. One of the steps may say, you know what? That's all I was supposed to do. And so I don't want to see any more input. And the example here will be, we're going to modify our instructions and say, if the bag is ticking, you're finished. Go home. We're done loading the plane. So we're going to add that. Taking while, taking while non-ticking.
cues.zh: 或者它可能是某一步的函数。某一步可能会说，你知道吗？这就是我该做的全部。所以我不想再看到更多输入。这里的例子会是，我们要修改指令，说如果袋子在滴答作响，你就完了。回家吧。我们装完飞机了。所以我们要加上这个。take while，take while non-ticking。

cues.en: And taking while non-ticking needs to stop the whole job in the middle. It doesn't matter if there's more stuff on the trolley. When it's ticking, we're finished. So how do we do that? cues.zh: 而 take while non-ticking 需要在中间停止整个任务。手推车上还有没有更多东西都无所谓。当它滴答作响时，我们就完成了。那我们怎么做呢？最后会落在闭包里。我们在 reduce 里已经支持这个想法。有一个叫 reduced 的特殊包装对象的构造函数，它表示这是……的结束。

cues.en: It just says, I don't want to see any more input. Here's what I've come up with so far, and don't give me any more input. And there's a predicate called reduced question mark that allows you to ask if something is in this wrapper. And there's a way to unwrap the thing and look at what's in it. So you can say, is the reduced thing reduced? That will always return true. And you can deref a reduced thing and get the thing that's inside it. This is not the same thing as maybe, because maybe also wraps the other things that are not reduced.
cues.zh: 它只是在说：我不想再看到任何输入了。这是我目前得到的结果，别再给我输入了。有个叫 reduced? 的谓词，可以让你问某个东西是否在这个包装里。也有办法拆开它，看看里面是什么。所以你可以问：这个 reduced 值是不是 reduced？这永远返回 true。对 reduced 值做 deref，就能拿到里面的东西。这和 maybe 不一样，因为 maybe 还会包装其他并非 reduced 的东西。

cues.en: Or all those other boxy kind of things. So we don't do that. We only wrap when we're doing this special termination. So like reduce, transducers also must support reduce. That means that the step functions are allowed to return a reduced value. And that if a transducing process or a transducer gets a reduced value, it must never call the step function with input again. That's the rule.
cues.zh: 或者所有那些别的盒状东西。所以我们不这么做。我们只在做这种特殊终止时才包装。所以和 reduce 一样，transducer 也必须支持 reduce。这意味着步进函数可以返回 reduced 值。而且，如果一个转换过程或一个 transducer 收到 reduced 值，它就绝不能再带着输入调用步进函数。这就是规则。

cues.en: Again, implement the rule in your type system, have at it. But that's the rule. So now we can look at the insides of taking while. It takes a predicate. It takes a step that it's going to modify. It runs the predicate on the input. If it's OK, it runs the step. If it's not OK, it takes what has been built up so far and says, we're finished, reduced result. That's how we bail out. But notice, the ordinary result is not in a wrapper.
cues.zh: 再说一遍，在你的类型系统里实现这条规则吧，随你。但规则就是这样。现在我们可以看看 take-while 的内部。它接收一个谓词。它接收一个将要修改的步进函数。它对输入运行谓词。如果通过，就运行步进函数。如果不通过，它就拿目前已经累积的结果，说我们结束了，返回 reduced 结果。我们就是这样提前退出的。但注意，普通结果并不在包装里。

cues.en: And so the reducing processes must also play this game. The transducer has to follow the rule from before. And a reducing process similarly has to support reduced. If it ever sees a reduced thing, it must never supply input again. The dereference value is the final accumulated value. But the final accumulated value is still subject to completion, which I'm going to talk about in a second. So there's a rule for the transducers as well. They have to follow this rule.
cues.zh: 所以归约过程也必须遵守这套规则。transducer 必须遵循之前那条规则。归约过程同样必须支持 reduced。只要它看到 reduced 值，就绝不能再提供输入。deref 出来的值就是最终累积值。但最终累积值仍然要经过完成阶段，我马上会讲。所以 transducer 也有一条规则。它们必须遵守这条规则。

cues.en: So now we get new pictorial types in the graphical type language. That is omnigraphal. So we can have a process that takes some black box at the prior step and an input and returns a black box at the next step. Or maybe, it returns a reduced version of that. So one of those two things can happen. Or, vertical bars, or.
cues.zh: 现在我们在图形化类型语言里有了新的图示类型。也就是 omnigraphal。于是我们可以有一个过程：它接收上一步的某个黑盒和一个输入，返回下一步的黑盒。或者，返回它的 reduced 版本。所以这两种情况之一会发生。或者，用竖线表示，或。

cues.en: And it returns another step function that similarly can take a different kind of input, a black box returns a black box, or a reduced black box. Same rules about successor-ship apply. So some interesting sequence functions require state. And in the purely functional implementations, they get to use the stack or laziness to put that state. They get somewhere in the execution machinery a place to put stuff.
cues.zh: 它返回另一个步进函数，这个函数同样可以接收另一种输入：一个黑盒，返回一个黑盒，或一个 reduced 黑盒。关于后继关系的同样规则也适用。所以一些有趣的序列函数需要状态。在纯函数式实现里，它们会利用栈或惰性来存放这个状态。它们在执行机制里找到某个地方来放东西。

cues.en: Now we're saying, I don't want to be in the business of specifying if we're lazy or not lazy or recursive. I'm not going to give you space inside the execution strategy because I'm trying to keep the execution strategy from you. And that means that state has to be explicit when you have transducers. Each transducer that needs state must create it. So examples of sequence functions that need state are take,
cues.zh: 现在我们说的是，我不想负责规定我们是惰性、非惰性还是递归。我不会在执行策略里给你留空间，因为我想把执行策略对你隐藏。这意味着使用 transducer 时，状态必须是显式的。每个需要状态的 transducer 都必须自己创建状态。需要状态的序列函数例子有 take，

cues.en: Partition, all, partition by, and things like that. They're counting, or they're accumulating some stuff to spit it out later. Where is that going to go? And it has to go inside the transducer object. They have to make state. And there's some rules about that. If you need state as a transducer author, you have to create it every time uniquely, and again, every time you're asked to transform a step function. So in new, you're going to create state every time you transform a step function.
cues.zh: Partition、all、partition by 之类的。它们在计数，或者在累积一些东西，以便之后输出。这些要放到哪里？它必须放在 transducer 对象内部。它们必须创建状态。这也有一些规则。如果你是 transducer 作者且需要状态，那么每次都要唯一地创建它，而且每次被要求转换步进函数时都要重新创建。所以在 new 里，每次转换步进函数时你都要创建状态。

cues.en: That means that if you build up a transducer stack, some of which are staple transducers, and you apply it, not when you build it, no state exists then. Now, after you called comp, there's no state. When you've applied it, you now have a new process step. But as we should be thinking about all transducer process steps, including the ones at the bottom, that may be stateful. You don't know that the very bottom process isn't launch stuff into space.
cues.zh: 这意味着，如果你构建一个转换器栈，其中一些是基础转换器，然后应用它——不是在构建它的时候应用，那时并不存在状态。现在，调用 comp 之后，也没有状态。当你应用它之后，你就有了一个新的处理步骤。但我们应该考虑所有转换器处理步骤，包括最底层的那些，它们可能是有状态的。你并不知道最底层的处理步骤不会把东西发射到太空里。

cues.en: So you should always treat an applied transducer stack as if it returned a stateful process, which means you shouldn't alias it. What ends up happening in practice is all of the transducible processes, they do the applying. It's not in the user's hands to do it. You pass around a transducer and input to the job. The job applies the transducer to its process, gets a fresh set of state when it does that, and there's no harm.

cues.en: You do have to do this by convention. So here's an example of a stateful transducer dropping while a predicate is true. So we start with our flag that says it's true. And then from then on forward, we're going to apply the step. So that is not the prettiest thing. I talked before about completion. So we have the idea of early termination. The other idea that transducers support is completion.
cues.zh: 你确实必须按约定这么做。下面是一个有状态转换器的例子：当谓词为真时进行丢弃。我们先从一个标志开始，它表示真。只要它仍为真，我们就丢弃。当我们发现它不为真时，就重置它，并继续应用步进。从那以后，我们就应用步进。所以这不是最漂亮的做法。我之前讲过完成。于是有了提前终止这个概念。转换器支持的另一个概念是完成。

cues.en: Which is that at the end of input, which may not happen, there'll be plenty of jobs that don't complete. They don't have ends. They're not consuming a finite thing like a collection. They're processing everything that comes through a channel or everything that comes through an event source. There's no end. But for things that have an end, there's a notion of completion, which is to say, if either the innermost process step

cues.en: wants to do something finally when everything's finished, they can. Or if any of the transducers have some flushing they need to do, they can do it. So the process may want to do a final transformation on the output. Any stateful transducer, in particular a transducer like Partition, it's aggregating to return aggregates. You say Partition 5, and it collects five things and spits it out. If you say we're done,
cues.zh: 想做最后处理时，可以在这时候做。或者如果某些转导器需要执行刷新操作，也可以在这时候做。所以这个过程可能想对输出做最后的转换。任何有状态的转导器，特别是像 Partition 这样的转导器，它是在聚合以返回聚合结果。你说 Partition 5，它会收集五个元素然后输出。如果你说已经完成了，

cues.en: It's got three things. It wants to spit out the three things. But you need to be able to tell it where we exhausted input. In order to do that, the way that's implemented in the closure implementation of transducers is that all the step functions must have a second operation. So there's the operation that takes a new input and the accumulated value so far and returns a new accumulated value or whatever. I mean, it's up to the process what the meaning of the black box is. But there must be another operation which takes just the
cues.zh: 它拿到了三个元素，想把这三个元素吐出来。但你得能通知它输入已经耗尽了。为了实现这一点，在 transducer 的闭包实现中，所有的步进函数都必须具备第二种操作。也就是既有接收新输入和当前的累积值、并返回新的累积值之类的操作——我是说，这个黑盒的具体含义取决于具体流程——但还必须有另一个操作，它只接收

cues.en: Accumulated value and no input so an already one operation So that's required so we'll talk about what that does or how that gets used right if the process itself if the overall job is has finished They've exhausted input or it has a notice a notion of being finished. This is not bailing out This is like there's nothing more to do. There's no more input ordinarily It must call the completion operation Exactly once on the accumulated value, so there's no more inputs. I'm going to call you once with no input
cues.zh: 传入累积值且没有新输入，也就是一元操作。这是必需的，我们会讲到它的作用以及如何使用。如果处理过程本身、或者整个任务已经完成，输入已经耗尽，或者有了“已完成”的概念——这并不是中途退出，而是确实无事可做了。通常在没有更多输入时，它必须对累积值恰好调用一次 completion 操作。既然没有更多输入了，我就会在不传输入的情况下调用你一次。

cues.en: Do whatever you want. Each transducer must do the same thing. It has to have one of these completion operations, and it must call its nested completion operation. It may, however, before it does that, flush. So if you have something like partition that's accumulated some stuff along the way, it can call the ordinary step function and then call complete on the result. And that's how we accomplish flushing.
cues.zh: 你想怎么做都行。每个 transducer 都必须做同样的事。它必须具备这类 completion 操作，而且必须调用其嵌套的 completion 操作。不过，在调用之前，它可以先执行 flush。因此，如果你有像 partition 这样沿途累积了一些数据的操作，它可以先调用普通的 step 函数，然后再对结果调用 complete。这就是我们实现 flush 的方式。

cues.en: There's just one caveat here, which is that if you're a stateful thing like partition, and you've ever seen reduced come up, well, the earlier rule says you can never call the input function. So you just drop whatever you have hanging around because somebody bowed out on this process. There's going to be no ordinary completion. So we can look at our types again in Omni Graphful 2000, latest programming innovation.
cues.zh: 这里只有一个需要注意的地方：如果你是像 partition 这样带状态的操作，而且遇到了 reduced，那么根据之前的规则，你绝不能再调用输入函数了。所以你只能把手头暂存的数据全丢掉，因为有人提前退出了流程，不会再有常规的完成阶段了。现在我们可以在最新的编程创新工具 Omni Graphful 2000 里再看看我们的类型。

And the second is the step operation that we've been seeing so far that takes a pair of those things and returns a pair of those things. That's it.
cues.zh: 我们可以把归约函数看作一对操作。它们在不同编程语言里形式各异，这并不重要。在 Clojure 里，单个函数就能同时包含这两种元数。但无论怎样，你需要支持两个操作：第一个不接收任何输入，是完成操作；第二个就是我们前面一直看到的步进操作，接收一对参数并返回结果。就是这样。

cues.en: And again, we don't want to concretely parameterize the result type there either, right? You got to use rank 2 polymorphism or something, because if you concretely parameterize that, you'll have something that only knows about transducing, you know, into airplanes as opposed to the general instructions. Okay. There's a third kind of operation that's associated with sort of processing in general, which is init. We've had talks before that mentioned monoids and things like that. The basic idea is just
cues.zh: 同样，我们也不想把那里的结果类型具体化，对吧？你得用 Rank-2 多态之类的机制，因为如果具体化了类型，它就只能把数据转换成某种特定类型（比如“飞机”），而无法表达通用的指令。好的。还有第三种通常与一般处理流程相关的操作，那就是 init。之前有演讲提到过幺半群之类的概念，其基本思想就是——

cues.en: Sometimes it's nice for a transformation operation to carry around an initialization capability. It need not be the identity value or anything like that. It does not matter. What does matter is that a reducing function is allowed to, may, support arity zero. In other words, given nothing at all, here's an initial accumulator value from nothing. Obviously, a transducer can't do that, because it's a black box.
cues.zh: 有时候，让变换操作自带初始化能力是很有用的。它不一定是单位元什么的，无所谓。重要的是，归约函数被允许——或者说可以——支持 0 元。换句话说，在没有任何输入的情况下凭空给出一个初始累加值。显然 transducer 做不到这点，因为它是个黑盒。

cues.en: It's even better. We want 100 functions with no data structure. So transducers are context independent. There's tremendous value in that. They're concretely reusable. So somebody can make this and not know how you're going to use it. That has tremendous value. It's much stronger than parameterization because you can flow it. It supports early termination. They support early termination completion. You can compose them just as easily as you can compose the other ones. They're efficient.
cues.zh: 这样甚至更好。我们要的是 100 个不依赖任何数据结构的函数。所以 transducer 是与上下文无关的。这具有巨大的价值。它们是实打实可复用的。别人写出它时，甚至不需要知道你会怎么去用它。这具有极大的价值。它比参数化强大得多，因为你可以让数据直接流转起来。它支持提前终止。它们支持提前终止和完成操作。你可以像组合其他函数一样轻松地组合它们。它们非常高效，
